questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Identify Azure file movement options
questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: One-way synchronization: using Azure File Sync to retain fast local access while centralizing file shares in Azure Files.
Azure Storage Explorer: the recommended standard account type for most blob, file, queue, and table storage scenarios.
AzCopy: AzCopy is used behind the scenes for many Storage Explorer file and blob operations.
AzCopy: a command-line utility for uploading, downloading, copying, and one-way synchronizing blobs and files.
One-way synchronization: AzCopy synchronization that copies changes from a designated source toward a destination rather than maintaining two-way sync.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: AzCopy — a command-line utility for uploading, downloading, copying, and one-way synchronizing blobs and files; and One-way synchronization — AzCopy synchronization that copies changes from a designated source toward a destination rather than maintaining two-way sync.
